verdict.rationale: Sierra documents grounding agents in your own knowledge, such as Help Center content, FAQs and policies, which you can view and edit in Agent Studio. Insights lets you see the reasoning behind every agent action or answer, including the knowledge sources it used. Missing for 10: evidence of inline, user-facing citations naming the specific article (attribution appears only in the operator Insights view), any guarantee that every answer is restricted to your own content, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
